_about: Washington Irving's legends and tales: The Sketch-Book (Rip Van Winkle, The Legend of Sleepy Hollow; undated in the text), Tales of a Traveller (undated in the text), The Alhambra (the revised edition, Fulton Edition, Century Co., 1910) and Legends of the Conquest of Spain (London: John Murray, MDCCCXXXVI on its title page; its preface sits in the front matter). His histories and biographies are not taken. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto). On 2026-10-17 every other English text by Washington Irving at Gutenberg was added (18 more books; dates are as each title page gives them, and many are undated in the text), at the coordinator's relay of Adam's keep-going message (Adam may veto). Second transcriptions of titles already here (0) and shared or misattributed files are listed in _excluded.
